result: Treating residual blocks as particles of a distribution over parameters and depth, a deep ResNet becomes a continuous ODE model whose loss has no bad local minima (any positive loss admits a descent direction, Theorem 3); the backpropagated signal stays bounded below by the loss, and the Wasserstein gradient flow reaches zero loss if it converges (Theorem 4).
result_plain: Mean-field continuous-depth ResNet: every local minimizer is global; flow converges to zero loss under assumptions.
